{{Top|leg}}
'''Sewfes''' were [[Balinaka]] communities on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Garnib]]. Each sewfes had a central community area known as a [[heswe]]. All Balinaka families lived in one of the sewfes, and most were powered by the excess geothermal energy generated by [[Crystal factory|crystal factories]]. Most sewfes were located by the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] due to the Balinaka's amphibious nature.
